description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Library' class in the core module of WPEFramework. It tests loading shared libraries, referencing them, and verifying their loaded status and errors.

classes.name: Library
classes.description: Represents a dynamically loadable library, providing methods to load functions, check load status, get error messages, and retrieve the library name.

methods.name: simpleSet
methods.description: A Google Test unit test that loads a library, retrieves a function, and verifies load status, errors, and library name.
